llms.body:
# WebHosting.dk

> WebHosting.dk (WebHosting A/S) is a Danish web hosting provider founded in 1996, offering shared hosting, mail hosting, and domain registration. All servers are located in Scandinavia in a hosting centre just outside Copenhagen. The company serves customers across Denmark and Europe and is known for low prices and high uptime (99.99%).

Dansk udgave: https://www.webhosting.dk/llms-da.txt

## Company

WebHosting A/S  
Naverland 2, DK-2600 Glostrup, Denmark  
Company number: 25674138  
Website: https://www.webhosting.dk  
Support: support@webhosting.dk  
Contact form: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/sendemail.php  
Support section: https://support.webhosting.dk  
Chatbot/contact: https://chatbot.webhosting.dk

European entity: MyWebToNet WebHosting Ltd, Lake House 2 Port Way, Port Solent, Hampshire, PO6 64TY, United Kingdom. Company number: 8011611. VAT: 132474724. Website: https://www.mywebtonet.com

Payment methods accepted: MobilePay, eDankort, Dankort, Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, Electron.

## Web Hosting Products

All hosting packages include: BackupMaster backup, spam filter, ClamAV/Cisco antivirus, SSL (free), FTP access, web cache, WebMail, Redis caching, 1-click WordPress install, all PHP versions (5.68.4), MySQL/MariaDB (4.18.4/10.3).

### PHP Basic (2 CPU)
- Web space: 20 GB
- Email space: 20 GB (8 GB per mailbox max)
- PHP memory limit: 1024 MB
- CPU: 100% (2 CPU)
- MySQL databases: 2 (1000 MB each)
- Email addresses: 20 | Mailboxes: 10
- Monthly traffic: 250 GB
- Price: 2 EUR/month (first 12 months), then 6 EUR/month
- Order: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/createoffernewadddomain.php?orderphpbasic=J

### PHP Medium (4 CPU)
- Web space: 30 GB
- Email space: 60 GB (16 GB per mailbox max)
- PHP memory limit: 1536 MB
- CPU: 400% (4 CPU)
- MySQL databases: 5 (1500 MB each)
- Email addresses: 50 | Mailboxes: 10
- Monthly traffic: 2500 GB
- Price: 3 EUR/month (first 12 months), then 8 EUR/month
- Order: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/createoffernewadddomain.php?orderphplite=J

### PHP Pro (8 CPU)
- Web space: 60 GB (listed as 46 GB on some pages)
- Email space: 120 GB (64 GB per mailbox max)
- PHP memory limit: 3072 MB
- CPU: 800% (8 CPU)
- MySQL databases: 10 (3000 MB each)
- Email addresses: 50 | Mailboxes: 10
- Monthly traffic: 10000 GB
- Price: 5 EUR/month (first 12 months), then 14 EUR/month
- Order: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/createoffernewadddomain.php?ordergrundprisphp=J

## Mail Hosting

- 60 GB mail space
- 10 IMAP/POP3 mailboxes (up to 64 GB per mailbox)
- 50 email addresses
- Access via PC, tablet, mobile
- Advanced WebMail (Roundcube)
- Free URL forwarder
- ClamAV/Cisco antivirus + spam filter
- Price: 2 EUR/month (first 12 months), then 5 EUR/month
- Order: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/createoffernewadddomain.php?ordermailhotel=J

## Domain Hosting

- Free DNS hosting and DNS manager
- 301 forwarding
- Instant registration
- Many TLDs available
- Domains from 9 EUR/year (.biz)
- Order/transfer: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/createoffernewadddomain.php?orderdomainonly=J
- Price list: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/prices.php
- Check if .DK domain is deactivated: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/dkdomainchecker.php

## Account Management

- Login: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/accountlogin.php
- Create account: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/createaccount.php
- Forgot password: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/accountsend.php
- Change password: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/changeaccountpwd.php
- Delete account: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/deleteaccount.php
- Disable 2FA: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/remove2fa.php
- WebMail login: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/webmaillogin.php
- Mailbox control panel: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/pop3setup.php
- Change mail password: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/changepassword.php
- Move domain/hosting to another account: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/changeaccount.php
- Cancel subscription: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/cancelhosting.php
- Cancel reseller account: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/cancelourinvoicing.php
- Validate email with ICANN: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/validateemail.php

## Support

- Support section: https://support.webhosting.dk/DKK
- Contact/chatbot: https://chatbot.webhosting.dk
- Contact form: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/sendemail.php
- Server status: https://www.webhosting.dk/cgi-bin/serverstatus.pl?merchant=webhosting.dk&language=ENG
- IP checker: https://www.webhosting.dk/ENG/ipcheck.php

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- WebHosting.dk has operated since 1996 and is one of Denmark's most experienced hosting providers.
- All servers are physically located in Scandinavia near Copenhagen  not in the cloud.
- The company does not offer phone support. Contact is via email or contact form only.
- Customers manage everything via the online control panel at webhosting.dk.
- SSL certificates are free for all hosting customers.
- Redis caching is free and available for all customers on PHP 7 or PHP 8.
- The support chatbot is available at https://chatbot.webhosting.dk
